# Richness

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

# Read the GeoJSON file
ny_counties_geo <- st_read("../Dataset/ny_counties_statistics.geojson")

# Convert FIPS in data_filtered to character to match the GeoJSON
data <- read.csv("../Dataset/v2_2023_gbif_ny.csv")
data_filtered <- subset(data, Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural > 0.05)
data_filtered$FIPS <- as.character(data_filtered$FIPS)

# Perform the join
ny_counties_data <- ny_counties_geo %>%
  left_join(data_filtered, by = "FIPS")

# Plot the choropleth map
ggplot(ny_counties_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = X2023_GBIF_Observation_Species_Richness), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "GBIF Species Richness (2023)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GBIF Species Richness (2023)",
       caption = "Data Source: GBIF 2023",
       fill = "Richness") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
# Bar plot assigned to a variable
bar_plot <- ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = reorder(COUNTYNAME, -X2023_GBIF_Observation_Species_Richness), 
                                      y = X2023_GBIF_Observation_Species_Richness)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", width = 0.7) +  # Add margin between bars
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GBIF Species Richness (2023)",
       x = "County", y = "Richness",
       caption = "Data Source: GBIF 2023") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)  # Increase text size for readability
  )

# Display the plot
print(bar_plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave("bar_plot_with_margins.png", plot = bar_plot, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
install.packages("psych")
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)  # For descriptive statistics

# Read the dataset
data <- read.csv("../Dataset/v2_2023_gbif_ny.csv")

# Filter the data
data_filtered <- subset(data, Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural > 0.05)

# Assign variables for analysis
species_richness <- data_filtered$X2023_GBIF_Observation_Species_Richness
percent_ag <- data_filtered$Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural
proportion_gbif_observations_ag <- data_filtered$GBIF_Agricultural_Disparity
proportion_ag_lands_not_near_gbif_observations <- data_filtered$Percent_Agricultural_Land_Near_GBIF

# ---------------------------------
# 4. Scatterplots with Trendlines
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nGenerating Scatterplots...\n")

# Scatterplot 1: median_household_income vs GBIF Disparity
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = percent_ag, y = species_richness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Percentage Agricultural Lands vs Species Richness",
       x = "% Agricultural Land",
       y = "Richness")

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Regression Analysis (Optional)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nRunning Regression Models...\n")

# Regression 1
model1 <- lm(species_richness ~ percent_ag, data = data_filtered)
summary_model1 <- summary(model1)
print(summary_model1)
```

# Shannon Index

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

# Read the GeoJSON file
ny_counties_geo <- st_read("../Dataset/ny_counties_statistics.geojson")

# Convert FIPS in data_filtered to character to match the GeoJSON
data <- read.csv("../Dataset/v2_2023_gbif_ny.csv")
data_filtered <- subset(data, Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural > 0.05)
data_filtered$FIPS <- as.character(data_filtered$FIPS)

# Perform the join
ny_counties_data <- ny_counties_geo %>%
  left_join(data_filtered, by = "FIPS")

# Plot the choropleth map
ggplot(ny_counties_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = X2023_GBIF_Observation_Shannon_Index), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "GBIF Shannon Index (2023)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "GBIF Shannon Index (2023)",
       caption = "Data Source: GBIF 2023",
       fill = "Shannon Index") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```


```{r}
install.packages("psych")
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)  # For descriptive statistics

# Read the dataset
data <- read.csv("../Dataset/v2_2023_gbif_ny.csv")

# Filter the data
data_filtered <- subset(data, Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural > 0.05)

# Assign variables for analysis
shannon_index <- data_filtered$X2023_GBIF_Observation_Shannon_Index
percent_ag <- data_filtered$Sum_Percent_Land_Use_Agricultural

# ---------------------------------
# 4. Scatterplots with Trendlines
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nGenerating Scatterplots...\n")

# Scatterplot 1: median_household_income vs GBIF Disparity
ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = percent_ag, y = shannon_index)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Percentage Agricultural Lands vs Shannon Index",
       x = "% Agricultural Land",
       y = "Shannon Index")

# ---------------------------------
# 5. Regression Analysis (Optional)
# ---------------------------------
cat("\nRunning Regression Models...\n")

# Regression 1
model1 <- lm(shannon_index ~ percent_ag, data = data_filtered)
summary_model1 <- summary(model1)
print(summary_model1)
```
